scripts.title: ANTIBANG MADE BY V0C0N
scripts.script:
spawn(function()
	while true do
		if (AntiBangEnabled) then
			Character = Player.Character
			Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
			RootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.RootPart

			if GetNearestPlayers() and Humanoid and RootPart and not IsVoiding then
				if (RanTP) then
					RootPart.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(1,50), 0, math.random(1,50))
				else
					IsVoiding = true

					local CurrentPosition = RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 and RootPart.CFrame or Camera.Focus
					local Timer = tick()
					local OldDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

					
					repeat
						workspace["\x46\x61\x6C\x6C\x65\x6E\x50\x61\x72\x74\x73\x44\x65\x73\x74\x72\x6F\x79\x48\x65\x69\x67\x68\x74"] = 0 / 0
						RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, VoidDepth, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
						RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
						task.wait()
					until tick() > Timer + AbDelay

					RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
					RootPart.CFrame = CurrentPosition

					Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)


					workspace["\x46\x61\x6C\x6C\x65\x6E\x50\x61\x72\x74\x73\x44\x65\x73\x74\x72\x6F\x79\x48\x65\x69\x67\x68\x74"] = OldDH
					IsVoiding = false
				end
			end
		end

		task.wait()
	end
end)

why u encodin FallenPartsDestroyHeight?

Bro, let me explain this script:

They converted FallenPartsDestroyHeight to hex (number system) because:

1. Game Can't Detect It
- The game's security system can't read it as normal text
- If you write "FallenPartsDestroyHeight" directly, you'll get banned
- But in hex form, the system can't detect it

2. Hiding
- So others can't immediately understand what the script does
- Most people can't read hex codes
- This keeps your actions secret

3. What Does It Do?
- Changes the void boundary in the game
- Normally you die when falling into void, but not with this
- Works as an anti-bang system

4. How Does It Work?
- Makes the void limit NaN (invalid number)
- Teleports you to void but you don't die
- Returns to normal after job is done
- Lets you exploit the void

Summary: Using these hex codes, you can trick the game's security system and stay in the void without dying. If you write it normally you'll get banned, but written this way the system doesn't understand it.

That's why they encode it like this: `\x46\x61\x6C\x6C\x65\x6E\x50\x61\x72\x74\x73\x44\x65\x73\x74\x72\x6F\x79\x48\x65\x69\x67\x68\x74`
